body:
Founder ask: publish a security notice at the top of the emily okemily funnel with a link to the news/press release (the Mid-Piano disclosure post from Apple #15895). Added .security-notice at the very top of index.html's .wrap, above the header -- same badge idiom as the existing .news-tag component, new --notice amber token (distinct from --accent on purpose, a notice isn't a link) verified WCAG AA in both light/dark (8.459:1 dark, 5.589:1 light against --bg-card). Links to https://okemily.com/blog/mid-piano-presents-the-memory-ceremony/. Deployed via ~/okemily-deploy.sh; live-verified 200, banner markup confirmed present.

⚓ ☃
title: Security notice banner on the okemily.com funnel
